sponsors.name: Google (Google for Developers)
sponsors.notes: Runs Google Solution Challenge (global student hackathon with ₹10 lakh prize pool), GDG on Campus program. Partners with colleges for hackathons via GDG chapters. Strong DevRel presence in India through GDG community.

sponsors.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
sponsors.notes: AWS Student Hackathon Grants program in partnership with Devfolio. Sponsors campus hackathons via AWS Builder Center. Active with 'AI for Bharat' hackathons. Provides cloud credits as sponsorship.

sponsors.name: Microsoft
sponsors.devrel_contact: Microsoft India Student Partners / Imagine Cup Team
sponsors.notes: Runs Imagine Cup (global student innovation competition with $50-100K prizes). Azure for Students program provides free credits. Active sponsor of college tech fests and hackathons in India.

sponsors.name: Meta (Facebook)
sponsors.notes: Partnered with Scaler School of Technology and Hugging Face for India's biggest AI hackathon (OpenEnv Hackathon 2026 with $30K prize pool). PyTorch is deeply integrated. Provides Meta AI API access to participants.

sponsors.name: GitHub
sponsors.notes: GitHub Campus Experts program supports student organizers. GitHub Education Pack for participants. Sponsors hackathons through community partnerships. Strong in Indian developer community with 27M+ Indian developers.

sponsors.name: Devfolio
sponsors.notes: India's #1 hackathon platform. Runs Student Hackathon Grants in association with AWS. Acts as operating system for hackathons - provides platform, funding, and sponsorship facilitation. Extensive India hackathon ecosystem.

sponsors.name: Postman
sponsors.notes: Runs Postman Student Programs and hackathons. 'Go With The Flows' hackathon series. Active in India through student communities and Discord. Provides Postman licenses and API expertise as sponsorship.

sponsors.name: MongoDB
sponsors.notes: Partners with AICTE for MongoDB for Academia program (upskilling 500K+ students). Runs 'Hack-N-Go with MongoDB' national hackathons. SmartBridge partnership for hackathon sponsorship in India.

sponsors.name: Supabase
sponsors.notes: Runs global Supabase Hackathons (Launch Week hackathons). Open source focused. Active developer community in India. Provides backend-as-a-service credits as sponsorship.

sponsors.name: Polygon
sponsors.notes: Launched 'BUIDL IT' - India's first Polygon-native hackathon ($100K prize pool). Active Web3 hackathon sponsor across Indian colleges. AlgoBharat program builds blockchain clubs in Indian engineering colleges.

sponsors.name: Hugging Face
sponsors.notes: Partnered with Meta for India's biggest AI hackathon with Scaler. Provides LLM access, mentorship, and job interview opportunities at Hugging Face. Growing presence in Indian AI community.

sponsors.name: JetBrains
sponsors.notes: Sponsors hackathons as supporting partner (Innovation Hackathon 2025). Runs JetBrains x Codex Hackathon globally. Provides All Products Pack and AI Ultimate as prizes. Known for IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm.

sponsors.name: Scaler (Abdul Samed Latif)
sponsors.notes: Scaler School of Technology runs India's biggest AI hackathon (70,000+ registrations). Co-branded hackathons with Meta and Hugging Face. Focused on building developer brand and recruiting talent.

sponsors.name: IBM
sponsors.notes: IBM SkillsBuild program for college students includes hackathons. IndiaAI Impact Gen-AI Hackathon with IISc. IBM Expert Labs National Hackathon. Uses watsonx and Granite models in hackathons.

sponsors.name: OpenAI
sponsors.notes: First official OpenAI hackathon held in Pune. Codex community meetups in India. Provides API credits and mentorship. Growing hackathon presence through developer community.

sponsors.name: Anthropic
sponsors.notes: Anthropic Hackathon at IIT Delhi as part of CBC Spring 2026 Global Hackathon (78 universities, 12 countries). Claude-focused hackathons. Sponsors AI hackathons with Google Cloud partnerships.

sponsors.name: Atlassian
sponsors.notes: Atlassian hackathon hosted at IIT Bombay (top 8 teams from India selected). Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket as sponsor tools. Community-focused sponsorship model.

sponsors.name: Figma
sponsors.notes: Sponsors hackathons as event sponsor with $200 Figma gift cards for winners. Active in Indian design community. Provides design tool access to participants.

sponsors.name: Vercel
sponsors.notes: Frequently sponsors meetups and hackathons globally. Meetup SDK for community events. Apply for sponsorship via community portal. India community growing rapidly.

sponsors.name: Stripe
sponsors.notes: Payments API sponsorship for fintech hackathons. Stripe Atlas and startup programs. Active in India's startup ecosystem. API credits as sponsorship.

sponsors.name: HashiCorp
sponsors.notes: Terraform, Vault, and Nomad-focused hackathons. Infrastructure-as-code sponsorship. Growing in Indian enterprise DevOps community.

sponsors.name: Neon (Neon Database)
sponsors.notes: Serverless Postgres for hackathons. Actively sponsors hackathons with cloud database credits. Growing presence in India's developer community.

sponsors.name: Render
sponsors.notes: Cloud hosting sponsorship for hackathons. Provides free hosting credits to participants. Active in student hackathon space.

sponsors.name: Algolia

sponsors.name: Twilio

sponsors.name: Freshworks

sponsors.name: CodeChef

sponsors.name: Miro

sponsors.name: DigitalOcean

sponsors.name: Oracle

sponsors.name: Wipro

sponsors.name: GDG Hyderabad (Google Developer Groups)
sponsors.sponsorship_history: Set Guinness World Record for largest Agentic AI Hackathon (2089+ participants, Dec 2025); organized Agentathon 2025 with 2300+ target participants; partnered with India Microsoft Fabric User Group for FebAIThon; major AI innovation hub in Hyderabad

sponsors.name: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors (MLSA)
sponsors.sponsorship_history: Gold MSA students can seek event sponsorship through Microsoft; ambassadors host workshops, meetups, hackathons on campus; Microsoft provides Azure credits, learning resources; Ambassadors have asked about sponsorship processes on Microsoft Q&A forums

sponsors.name: GitHub Campus Experts (India)
sponsors.sponsorship_history: Student leaders organizing tech events across India; upcoming events include GDG AI HACK 2026, HackArena 2.0 Mumbai, SparkJam; GitHub Education Pack available for participants; serves as recommended channel for student-organized hackathons on GitHub platform

sponsors.name: AWS User Groups India
sponsors.sponsorship_history: AWS Amplify Hackathon hosted with AWS User Group India; Community Days in Chennai, Bengaluru; sponsors include Freshworks, Amazon Alexa, JFrog for AWS Community Day 2019; partnered with Devfolio for Student Hackathon Grants program

sponsors.name: HackWithIndia
sponsors.sponsorship_history: India's biggest hackathon community with 50000+ developers; provides $99 credits for all participants; free t-shirts, meals, swags; monetary prizes for winners; campus chapters across India; industry-backed challenges

sponsors.name: Telangana IT, Electronics & Communication Department
sponsors.contact: https://startup.telangana.gov.in/; IT Department, Government of Telangana
sponsors.sponsorship_history: Supports T-Hub (India's largest innovation hub); T-Fund provides INR 25 lakhs to 1 crore funding for early-stage tech startups; SISF supports PoC, prototyping; runs events including Idea Validation Bootcamps, Assistive Technology Exhibitions; sponsors innovation programs in Hyderabad

sponsors.name: Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM)

sponsors.name: MeitY (Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology)

sponsors.name: IndiaAI Mission

sponsors.name: Samsung India CSR (Samsung Innovation Campus)

sponsors.name: Intel India CSR

sponsors.name: Qualcomm India CSR

sponsors.name: Y Combinator / Emergent Ventures
